Functions:

DDL to be executed:

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION random_id()
RETURNS bigint
LANGUAGE sql
VOLATILE
AS $$
    SELECT CAST(1000000000 + floor(random() * 9000000000) AS bigint);
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS x (
    id bigint DEFAULT random_id(),
    CONSTRAINT x_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION x_rows()
RETURNS TABLE(r x)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN;
END;
$$;
